FlexibleHierarchy.name: FlexibleHierarchy
FlexibleHierarchy.description: Represents the structure and hierarchy of relationships among individuals or entities within an organization or between organizations.

CurrencyIsoCode.description: Three-letter ISO currency code associated with the hierarchy.

EffectiveFromDate.description: The date when this hierarchy becomes effective.

EffectiveToDate.description: The date until when this hiearchy remains effective.

HierarchyTypeReferenceId.description: The hierarchy type associated with the flexible hierarchy.

IsActive.description: Indicates if the hierarchy is active (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date when a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date when a user viewed this record.

OwnerId.description: The owner of the flexible hierarchy record.

RootRecord.description: The ID of the record that's the root of this hierarchy.

RootRecordObject.description: The API name of the object that's the root of this hierarchy.

SourceSystemIdentifier.description: The unique identifier of this record in an external system.

SourceSystemName.description: The name of the external system this record was obtained from.

Status.description: Specifies the current state of the hierarchy in its lifecycle.

ValidationError.description: The error message generated while validating the structure of this hierarchy.
